description: Internet Archive history of a website: first and latest Wayback Machine snapshot (date and link) and how long the site has existed online. Useful for trust checks and research. Takes 1-5 s. Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
